steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.detail: Cook 220 g dry rice. Portion 100 g cooked rice into each box.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
steps.detail: Cook the chicken until the thickest part reaches 74°C. Portion 120 g cooked into six containers.

steps.title: Prepare the six dinners
steps.detail: Sunday and Wednesday salmon, Monday and Thursday lean beef, Tuesday white fish, Friday turkey. Each with potato, 100 g cooked lentils, and 300 g vegetables.

steps.title: Prepare breakfast parts
steps.detail: Portion 60 g oats into six bags or jars. Keep yogurt, bananas, and frozen berries ready.

steps.title: Plan school lunch
steps.detail: Lunch comes from the cafeteria. Nothing needs refrigeration from home. Buy eggs and tofu only if the cafeteria does not have them.

steps.title: Label every container
steps.detail: Write the day and the meal on each container.

steps.title: Refrigerate Sunday to Wednesday
steps.detail: Keep Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday meals in the fridge.

steps.title: Freeze Thursday and Friday
steps.detail: Freeze Thursday and Friday meals as soon as they have cooled.

steps.title: Thaw the night before
steps.detail: Move a frozen meal to the fridge the night before you need it.

steps.title: Two hour rule
steps.detail: Refrigerate or freeze cooked food within two hours.

steps.title: Fridge temperature
steps.detail: Keep the fridge at or below 4°C.

steps.title: Leftover limit
steps.detail: Use refrigerated leftovers within three to four days.

claimReviews.claimed: As the user described it, since the video could not be opened: train each muscle head with its own exercise, do three sets to failure, and pick exercises that stretch the muscle.
claimReviews.evidence: The link was still blocked, so the video itself was not seen. The description was compared with studies in SOURCES: growth rises a little as sets get closer to failure (Robinson 2024), but failure and one or two reps in reserve gave the same growth (Refalo 2024). Training at long muscle lengths helped in trials of the seated leg curl, overhead triceps work, and calf raises (Maeo 2021 and 2023, Kassiano 2023). About 9 to 18 weekly sets per muscle is supported (Pelland 2025). These are adult studies.
claimReviews.verdict: Mostly supported, with one change. PeakForm 2.0 uses one exercise per muscle head, three work sets, and stretch focused exercises. Failure is used on machine and cable work, where a failed rep is safe when training alone, and dumbbell presses, lunges, and hinges stop one rep short, which grew muscle just as well.

claimReviews.claimed: As the user described it, together with the first video: one exercise for each muscle head, three sets to failure, and exercises with a stretch.
claimReviews.evidence: The link was still blocked and the video was not seen. The claim was reviewed as one claim with the first video, against the same sources.
claimReviews.verdict: Reviewed with the first video. The same changes in PeakForm 2.0 apply.
